document.abstract: The SMPTE 2013 Progress Report reflects ongoing changes across the media and entertainment industry, as well as the work that the Society has undertaken to address these changes and facilitate forward progress. Within this report, SMPTE's standards partners and industry associations have provided articles on relevant activities in their organizations, and numerous experts have provided status updates on particular technology areas of interest.
